view_frame: The primary view is TOP (XY plane), showing the handle's footprint. The X-axis represents width (left-right), and the Y-axis represents depth (up-down in the view). The Z-axis represents height (vertical, out of the page). The 'END SECTION' view shows the cross-section perpendicular to the path.

features.placement: The path consists of two straight legs and one semicircular bend. The bend is centered at (0, 30) with a radius of 20 mm, spanning from angle 0 to 180 degrees (counter-clockwise). The right leg extends from (20, 30) to (20, 0). The left leg extends from (-20, 30) to (-20, 0). The section center is at Z=4 mm (radius of 8mm/2).
features.evidence: Top view shows a U-shape. Text 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm' defines the path geometry. 'END SECTION' shows a circle labeled 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The straight legs are tangent to the semicircular bend at the transition points (±20, 30).
edit_rules: Changing the 'diameter' updates the section size and the Z-offset of the centerline.
Changing 'R20' updates the bend radius and the X-coordinates of the legs.
Changing '30 mm' updates the length of the straight legs and the Y-coordinate of the bend center.
